observations: Two manual sewing machine stands with treadle pedals and table tops.
One table top has a blue marble-effect pattern and a printed ruler on the edge (Photo 2).
One table top has a wood-grain pattern (Photo 3).
Cast iron legs are painted black.
The text 'SUMO PREMIUM' is embossed on the foot pedals in photos 2 and 3.
A green industrial-style motor is partially visible on the ground in photo 3, but not attached.
No sewing machine heads are visible in any photo.
Photos contain 'SESHMAK TECH' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermarks.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows two sets of stands/legs.
Sumo Premium is a common brand for imported goods in Nigeria, but no 'Made in Japan' mark is visible.
The stands are manual treadle types; a separate motor is visible on the ground in photo 3 but is not shown powered or connected.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories or manuals are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism or wheel bearings may be seized or noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip of the wheel being spun freely by the foot pedal.

risks.risk: Table tops may be warped or have water damage (swelling) not visible from the top.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and the side edges of the wooden boards.

risks.risk: Drive belts connecting the wheel to a machine head are likely missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing the leather or rubber drive belts.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle wheels spinning to confirm they are not seized.
Photos of the underside of the table tops to check for rot or warping.
Photos of the manual and accessories mentioned in the text.
Clear photo of the motor and its specifications if it is included in the price.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as manual sewing machine stands. Although the seller's claims regarding a motor and Japanese origin are unproven, the stands can be priced as generic manual units in their current state.
